note: Cropping a picture. A picture's crop is how much of each side is cut off, as fractions of the whole picture: left, top, right, bottom. The object's box shows what is left, at the picture's own scale; the whole picture is drawn under a clip. The object's menu crops the selected pictures to a square, 4:3 or 16:9 around their middle, or gives back the whole picture.

computed.cropItems: {{computed.pictureSelected ? [{ title: 'Crop to Square', icon: 'crop', run: 'cropPictures', with: { ratio: 1 } }, { title: 'Crop to 4:3', icon: 'crop', run: 'cropPictures', with: { ratio: 4 / 3 } }, { title: 'Crop to 16:9', icon: 'crop', run: 'cropPictures', with: { ratio: 16 / 9 } }, { title: 'Whole Picture', icon: 'image', run: 'cropPictures', with: { ratio: null } }, { separator: true }] : []}}

cropPictures.note: with: ratio: crops the selected pictures to those proportions around their middle, at the same scale and centred where they were (null: the whole picture)

cropMeasured.note: with: pic, ratio, and ww and wh, the size the whole picture is drawn at: how much to cut from each side

with.cutX: {{ratio != null && ww / max(wh, 0.01) > ratio ? (1 - ratio / (ww / max(wh, 0.01))) / 2 : 0}}
with.cutY: {{ratio != null && ww / max(wh, 0.01) < ratio ? (1 - (ww / max(wh, 0.01)) / ratio) / 2 : 0}}

cropPicture.note: with: pic, ww, wh, ratio, cutX and cutY: the picture cropped, at the same scale, centred where it was

cropPicture.to: {{map(computed.objects, it.id != pic.id ? it : merge(it, { crop: ratio == null ? null : [cutX, cutY, cutX, cutY], w: round(ww * (1 - 2 * cutX)), h: round(wh * (1 - 2 * cutY)), x: round(pic.x + pic.w / 2 - ww * (1 - 2 * cutX) / 2), y: round(pic.y + pic.h / 2 - wh * (1 - 2 * cutY) / 2) }))}}
